rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for expressing deep respect, including respect shown in a sacred context.

example.english: We have always held deep reverence for the firefighters who served Hong Kong all their lives.
example.traditional: 我哋對為香港服務一世嘅消防員，始終抱有深深嘅敬意。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 wai6 hoeng1 gong2 fuk6 mou6 jat1 sai3 ge3 siu1 fong4 jyun4 ci2 zung1 pou5 jau5 sam1 sam1 ge3 ging3 ji3

rows.note: Use this when the reverence stresses awe or fear before a deity, sacred power, or something greater than oneself.

example.english: Standing at the foot of the snowy mountain, I could not help feeling reverence for the power of nature.
example.traditional: 企喺雪山腳下，我對大自然嘅力量不禁產生敬畏。
example.jyutping: kei5 hai2 syut3 saan1 goek3 haa6 ngo5 deoi3 daai6 zi6 jin4 ge3 lik6 loeng6 bat1 gam1 caan2 saang1 ging3 wai3

rows.note: Use this for elevated veneration of a deity or highly admired person, especially in more formal or written language.

example.english: The public hold deep reverence for this principal who devoted his whole life to education.
example.traditional: 市民對呢位終身奉獻教育嘅校長充滿崇敬。
example.jyutping: si5 man4 deoi3 ne1 wai6 zung1 san1 fung6 hin3 gaau3 juk6 ge3 haau6 zoeng2 cung1 mun5 sung4 ging3
